stanza: With bruises on my chin, the time when
We counted every black car passing
And up until someone caught us in the kitchen
With maps, a mountain range, a piggy bank
A vision too removed to mention

q.line: Dying by the hand of a foreign man happily
stanza: Catch me if you can, working on my tan
Dying by the hand of a foreign man happily
Calling out my name in the summer rain
Now it's time to eat soft ice cream
